name: Akrabbim
overview: Akrabbim refers to a notable chain of hills located in the southern region of Palestine, marking a significant boundary in the biblical landscape. Scripture describes this ascent as a southern border point for the land allotments given to Israel, as seen in Numbers 34:4 and Joshua 15:3, where it is associated with the southern border near Kadeshbarnea. Judges 1:36 also references Akrabbim in delineating the territory of the Amorites, emphasizing its role as a geographic landmark in God's providential division of the Promised Land.
